name: dialog
title: Dialog
description: A window overlaid on either the primary window or another dialog window, rendering the content underneath inert.

files.content:
// Guide: /docs/creating-components · adapter internals: /docs/zag-adapter // Authoring rules: notes/component-authoring.md (v2 pattern) import * as dialogMachine from "@zag-js/dialog"; import type { MachineInput } from "marko-zag"; import Button from "../button/button.marko"; import Icon from "../icon/icon.marko"; import { cn } from "../../../lib/utils.ts"; import { stripOwnProps } from "../../../lib/native-attrs.ts"; export type Input = MachineInput<"div", dialogMachine.Props> & { openChange?: (open: boolean) => void; trigger?: Marko.Body<[Record]>; title?: Marko.Body; description?: Marko.Body; content?: Marko.Body; footer?: Marko.Body; /** Show the top-right close button. Defaults to true. */ showCloseButton?: boolean; }; dialogMachine.machine props=machineProps/> dialogMachine.connect(service, normalizeProps) service=service /> stripOwnProps( dialogMachine.splitProps(input)[1], "class", "openChange", "trigger", "title", "description", "content", "footer", "showCloseButton", ) > <${input.trigger}({ ...api().getTriggerProps(), "data-slot": "dialog-trigger" })/> // NOTE: upstream shadcn sets data-slot="dialog-portal" on Radix's Portal, // which renders a real element. marko-zag's renders a // `display:contents` host and does not forward attributes, so the // marker never reached the DOM — it was inert, and nothing in this // repo's CSS, tests or tooling reads it. Dropped rather than left as // dead markup; restore it if gains attribute forwarding.

<${input.title}/>

<${input.description}/>

<${input.content}/>
<${input.footer}/>
